summary: Scripts are excellent (proper types, error handling, pure functions). Workflow structure uses GitHub Actions best practices (pinned versions, frozen lockfile, least-privilege permissions) but critically incomplete: missing actionlint validation step (required by task), doesn't create/reference act-result.txt (required artifact), hard-codes fixture paths without setup, and depends on undefined package.json/tsconfig.json. Would fail to run in `act` without these dependencies. Test job runs `bun test` but test files not shown; validate-secrets job references fixtures (mixed.json, all-ok.json) without verifying they exist.
